skill: Differentiate a polynomial raised to a positive integer power using the chain rule; evaluate slopes and form tangent lines in the documented higher-difficulty families.
reasoning_steps: Identify inner polynomial g and outer power n.
Compute n*g^(n-1) and g prime independently, multiply and substitute.
For slope questions evaluate at the supplied abscissa; for tangent questions use the slope and point.
response_contract: Easy source questions use five-choice radio or a symbolic blank; moderate uses polynomial derivative blanks or numerical slope radio/blanks; hard uses tangent expression blank/radio.
difficulty: Easy: affine inner polynomial, integer outer powers 3,4,6. Nonlinear derivative and slope families are moderate; tangent families hard. Undesignated q-48625 has quartic inner polynomial.
invariants: One polynomial inner function and positive integer outer power; no radicals or transcendental outer functions.
All dependent expressions and coordinates derive from the same polynomial, power and target.
Radio options are distinct with exactly one derivative/slope/tangent answer.
Blank grading accepts algebraically equivalent polynomials.
permitted_variations: Vary nonzero coefficients and signs, constants, outer exponent, source-supported polynomial degrees and variable names within comparable workload.
Vary evaluation abscissa and consequent ordinate, slope sign and zero/nonzero outcomes where valid.
Reorder inner terms or answer choices without changing mathematical correctness. Correct position and distractor size/order are incidental.
Relevant coefficient/exponent/target changes must update answer and solution; irrelevant term ordering must preserve answer.
gaps: q-48625 lacks stored correct-answer link, difficulty and worked solution. Its derivative is independently recoverable as 2(x^4+3x)(4x^3+3).
q-340690 blank choices include an incorrect -28(1-7x) alternative; only the linked -28(1-7x)^3 is correct.
Captured redundant escaping/braces should be normalized, not reproduced as malformed math.

provenance.confirmed: All 13 cited question identities and both tutorial passages checked in original source before package inspection; source/policy binding matched by runner.
